geometry.topologyIntent: Revolved drawn-steel can with a generously rounded bottom edge and a joint groove; its top runs up hidden inside the band.
Band core round the stator carrying 32 vertical fins; the cap wall hides its top edge.
Revolved cap: wall down over the band top, rounded top rim, flat top face with a shallow dish round the boss.
Bearing shield floor of the recess.
Rounded bearing boss in the recess.
Ground steel collar at the shaft root.
Cross-drilled pin hole near the tip.
Chamfered crown of the bolt head.
